mapper.select: SELECT * FROM pur_order_import_task WHERE country_id=#{countryId} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE pur_order_import SET match_task_id=#{matchTaskId} WHERE country_id=#{countryId} AND id=#{id}
UPDATE pur_order_import_task SET result=#{result}::jsonb,phase='IMAGE' WHERE country_id=#{countryId} AND id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT i.id,i.image_sha256,r.association_status FROM pur_order_import_row_image r JOIN pur_order_import_image i ON i.country_id=r.country_id AND i.id=r.image_id JOIN pur_order_import_source s ON s.country_id=i.country_id AND s.id=i.source_id WHERE r.country_id=#{countryId} AND r.row_id=#{rowId} AND s.batch_id=#{batchId} AND r.association_status IN ('UNCONFIRMED','CONFIRMED') ORDER BY i.id
mapper.update: UPDATE pur_order_import_task SET input_data=#{inputData}::jsonb WHERE country_id=#{countryId} AND id=#{id}
UPDATE pur_order_import_task SET result=#{result}::jsonb,phase='EXPLAIN' WHERE country_id=#{countryId} AND id=#{id}

UPDATE pur_order_import_task SET status='STALE',error_code='INPUT_CHANGED',error_message=#{errorMessage},credential_hash=NULL,lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL WHERE country_id=#{countryId} AND id=#{id}
UPDATE pur_order_import SET match_result=#{matchResult}::jsonb WHERE country_id=#{countryId} AND id=#{id}

UPDATE pur_order_import_task SET status=#{status},phase='DONE',result=#{result}::jsonb,callback_hash=#{callbackHash},callback_credential_hash=credential_hash,credential_hash=NULL,lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,error_code=#{errorCode},error_message=#{errorMessage} WHERE country_id=#{countryId} AND id=#{id}
